page_title: ESP 2-2 VAL | Espanyol v Valencia 23/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Jose Guzman is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' 2 - 2 Javi Puado (Espanyol) rises highest and produces a wonderful header to send the ball inside the right post!
90+4' Julen Agirrezabala (Valencia) is punished with the yellow card.
90+2' Javi Puado (Espanyol) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Julen Agirrezabala anticipates well and smothers the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Hugo Duro (Valencia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
87' The attendance for today's match is 26802.
86' Exposito (Espanyol) sends a cross into the box, but Julen Agirrezabala comes off his line to gather the ball.
85' Exposito (Espanyol) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.

84' Espanyol are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
82' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jose Salinas (Espanyol) replacing Carlos Romero.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) comes onto the pitch for Tyrhys Dolan.
79' Exposito (Espanyol) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.

77' The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick. A sweet pass inside the box gives Kike Garcia (Espanyol) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
76' Substitution. Luis Rioja makes way for Javi Guerra (Valencia).
76' Carlos Corberan has decided to substitute Jose Gaya and he is replaced by Jesus Vazquez (Valencia).
74' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
74' Javi Puado (Espanyol) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arnaut Danjuma departs the field of play to be replaced by Thierry Correia (Valencia).
70' Lucas Beltran (Valencia) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
68' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to make a change. Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol) replaces Omar El Hilali.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) comes onto the pitch so that Pol Lozano can be given a rest.
66' Wow, what an escape. Kike Garcia (Espanyol) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
65' The Espanyol players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

62' 1 - 2 Goal! Filip Ugrinic launched the corner kick and superbly found the head of Hugo Duro (Valencia), whose accurate effort from near the penalty spot went straight into the bottom left corner. It's 1:2.
62' The referee awards a corner and Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) goes over to take it.

61' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The linesman points to the corner flag, Valencia are going to take it.
60' We are about to witness a substitution. Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) is replacing Pepelu.
60' Here is a change. Diego Lopez is going off and Carlos Corberan gives the last tactical orders to Lucas Beltran (Valencia).

59' 1 - 1 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go low into the middle of the net. The score changes to 1:1.
58' Exposito (Espanyol) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

58' Javi Puado (Espanyol) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Espanyol have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) replaces Charles Pickel.
56' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
56' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman makes the right call and Valencia will have a corner.
55' The referee blows his whistle after Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. Valencia have a free kick.
54' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Baptiste Santamaria (Valencia) was quite harsh and Jose Guzman didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
51' Javi Puado (Espanyol) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
50' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) meets a cross inside the box, but Julen Agirrezabala wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
49' Exposito (Espanyol) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
47' Espanyol are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Luis Rioja (Valencia). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
45+2' The ball is cleared after Diego Lopez (Valencia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Valencia earn a corner.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.

45' The corner is aimed towards the penalty spot where it's met by Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol), but his timing is poor and it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
45' Exposito (Espanyol) will deliver the corner kick.
45' The referee signals a corner kick to Espanyol. Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Pol Lozano (Espanyol) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
43' Diego Lopez (Valencia) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Guzman had an easy-decision to make.
42' Exposito (Espanyol) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
42' Julen Agirrezabala leaps to intercept the corner kick from Exposito (Espanyol).

41' What a great touch by Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Espanyol force their opponents to concede a corner.

39' A dangerous towering header by Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
38' Exposito (Espanyol) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
38' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) gets booked.
38' Charles Pickel (Espanyol) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.

37' Javi Puado (Espanyol) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The ball goes out for a corner. Espanyol can continue in their attacking effort.
37' Exposito (Espanyol) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

36' Exposito (Espanyol) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball is out of play. Espanyol win a corner kick.
34' Espanyol show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
32' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom left corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Julen Agirrezabala. What a save!
32' The resulting corner from Exposito (Espanyol) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
30' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
29' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
29' Jose Gaya (Valencia) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is out of play. Espanyol will take a throw-in.
27' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
25' Wonderful movement by Valencia. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
23' Exposito (Espanyol) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

23' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Espanyol are awarded a corner kick.

22' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Espanyol are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
19' Espanyol showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. It's a throw-in for Valencia.
17' Javi Puado (Espanyol) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
15' 0 - 1 Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) meets a perfect cross from Luis Rioja deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike inside the left post. It's 0:1.
14' Hugo Duro (Valencia) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.

13' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms around the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
12' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

9' The ball rebounds out to Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
9' Valencia seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
7' Hugo Duro (Valencia) gets on the end of a good cross and shoots, but his attempt is inadvertently blocked by one of his own teammates.
6' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Valencia.
4' Javi Puado (Espanyol) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
3' The game is interrupted now, Exposito (Espanyol) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

1' Nice individual effort by Kike Garcia (Espanyol). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the middle of the goal, but Julen Agirrezabala does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Espanyol will kick the game off.
